objective: Convert the newly added detail-material microstructure from normalized per-primitive UV placement to deterministic manufacture-scale metric UVs with per-piece cut-origin phase diversity, because native 4K realism can regress if identical apartment modules restart the same normal/metallic pattern or if extrusion/corrugation scale changes with component dimensions.

changes.summary: Adds persisted metric UV0 rebakes for every non-LOD-proxy DanchiHighDetail renderer. Chamfered components use a local orthonormal projection aligned to the longest manufactured axis; cylinders use axial metres plus near-metric circumference with whole-repeat seam closure. Each separate part receives a deterministic 8x8 FNV-derived phase at 17 mm steps.

Adds fail-closed machine/runtime validation of the contract, scene manifest, source-renderer count, six material scales, persisted physical-UV mesh identities, recomputed phase tokens, UV/tangent completeness, phase diversity, and deep chamfer-edge UV-metre isometry. The lightweight form runs on every formal 3840x2160 still/temporal pre-cull.

Binds metric UV conversion directly after dimension-baked bevel geometry and before Danchi LOD proxy generation, so LOD1/2/3 inherit the same physical mesh assets rather than reintroducing normalized primitive UVs. Bevel validation now also requires physical-UV validation.

Defines metre-space placement, six canonical repeats-per-metre values, deterministic phase policy, QA thresholds, native 4K crops, critical-risk mappings, zero automatic visual points and explicit limitations.
Lookdev diagram documenting long-axis aluminum extrusion grain, cylindrical hose wrap/axial mapping and per-module phase diversity. Explicitly non-render evidence.

Removes stale limitations claiming normalized procedural UVs and unavoidable identical material phase; now states that metric placement/phase are supplied by the physical-UV pass while actual rendered repetition and temporal stability remain unresolved until native evidence.

manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.separate_part_phase: Window extrusions, brackets, bolts, seals and service components are distinct manufactured/cut pieces. Their microscopic stock origin should not reset to an identical texture origin at every apartment bay; deterministic per-object phase approximates independent cut/form origins without random frame-to-frame state.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.anodized_aluminum: The micro-normal height field varies across U so its grain lines run along V. For box-like extrusions the longest available manufactured component axis is deliberately chosen as V, making the fine anodized/extrusion response run along sash/rail members.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.galvanized_steel: Metric placement keeps zinc-like mottling scale independent of bolt/bracket dimensions while deterministic phase avoids repeated hardware sharing the same visible patch origin.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.epdm_rubber: Gasket macro thickness and routing remain geometry; only fine elastomer grain is tiled in metre-space so narrow/long seals do not stretch a 0..1 texture differently.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.aged_abs_ac: Casing panel form remains geometry; fine orange-peel relief is metrically stable rather than scaling with each box face.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.pipe_insulation_cover: Pipe bends/collars remain geometry; wrap-skin microrelief uses metre-space placement so different-length segments retain a stable surface scale.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.pvc_drain_hose: The generator varies height along V to form circumferential ribs. Cylindrical UV V is axial metres, so this produces rings around the hose. U follows circumference; the wrap is rounded to an integer texture repeat to close the tangent-space normal seam.

selfAudit: The quality-build call chain was verified source-side: QualityBlock4KCapture rebuilds GroundDetail -> FoliageOptics -> TreeDetail -> DanchiLod; DanchiLod invokes DetailBevel, and DetailBevel now applies physical UVs before it creates LOD proxies. This makes the new pass part of the normal prepared-scene path rather than an optional menu-only operation.

Source renderers explicitly exclude HD_LOD proxy descendants. LOD proxies are created after physical conversion and share the already converted mesh/material assets, avoiding phase recomputation from proxy hierarchy paths.

Reapplying the pass is deterministic: previously generated _PU/_PV mesh suffixes are stripped back to the GM_HD source identity and UVs are recomputed from geometry, not incrementally transformed from old UVs.

A stale statement in detail_material_microstructure_contract.json still claimed normalized primitive UVs and unresolved identical phase. That documentation/contract inconsistency was corrected in commit 7ea6514; actual native-pixel repetition remains explicitly unresolved.

Cylinder circumference density is intentionally allowed a bounded deviation from exact metre density because the circumference is rounded to a whole texture repeat to avoid a tangent-space normal seam. This is not self-scored and must be reviewed in balcony_services/temporal evidence.

Physical UV correctness is enforced before formal MainCamera renders through pre-cull QA and is part of Bevel validation in the prepared-scene build. Reflection probes themselves do not invoke Camera.onPreCull; although later sealed still evidence cannot pass if UV state is wrong, an explicit pre-RenderProbe physical-UV binding remains a possible source-side hardening task if no Runner appears first.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded: Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: positive potential because microstructure scale is now tied to manufactured metres instead of normalized face dimensions.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: positive potential because anodized grain and hose corrugation have explicit orientation semantics rather than arbitrary primitive UV orientation.
Critical obvious_repetition risk: positive potential because repeated apartment components receive stable per-piece phase diversity rather than identical texture origin.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: neutral-to-positive intent only. LOD proxies inherit the same physical mesh/material state, but normal-map shimmer and LOD transition visibility are actual-render decisions.
No category receives numeric Visual Fidelity points without sealed native 3840x2160 evidence.
